tool.name: IMAGINE-X subhkl Careless Merge
tool.command:
mkdir -p out ; ln -sf "$reflections" input_reflections.mtz ;
METADATA_KEYS=\$(python -c " import gemmi, reciprocalspaceship as rs mtz = gemmi.read_mtz_file('input_reflections.mtz') c = mtz.cell na = 90.0 if abs(c.alpha - 90) < 0.2 else (120.0 if abs(c.alpha - 120) < 0.2 else c.alpha) nb = 90.0 if abs(c.beta - 90) < 0.2 else (120.0 if abs(c.beta - 120) < 0.2 else c.beta) ng = 90.0 if abs(c.gamma - 90) < 0.2 else (120.0 if abs(c.gamma - 120) < 0.2 else c.gamma) mtz.cell.set(c.a, c.b, c.c, na, nb, ng) mtz.write_to_file('input_cell.mtz') ds = rs.read_mtz('input_cell.mtz') if 'SIGI' in ds: ds = ds[ds['SIGI'] > 0] if not ds.get_m_isym_keys(): ds = ds.hkl_to_asu() ds.merged = False ds.write_mtz('input_unmerged.mtz')
cols = {col.label for col in mtz.columns} keys = ['WAVEL','THETA','PHI','dHKL','H_0','K_0','L_0','H','K','L','image_id','file_id','asu_id','harmonic_id'] for extra in ('SIGEFF', 'SNAPD', 'DPHI', 'DTX', 'DTY', 'DTZ'): if extra in cols: keys.append(extra) print(','.join(keys)) ") ;
#set $options = " --jit-compile --wavelength-key=WAVEL " #if str($studenttDof) != "": #set $options = $options + " --studentt-likelihood-dof=" + str($studenttDof) + " " #end if #if str($dmin) != "": #set $options = $options + " --dmin=" + str($dmin) + " " #end if #if str($isigiCutoff) != "": #set $options = $options + " --isigi-cutoff=" + str($isigiCutoff) + " " #end if #if $mergeHalfDatasets: #set $options = $options + " --merge-half-datasets " #end if #if $anomalous: #set $options = $options + " --anomalous " #end if
careless poly --iterations=$iterations $options "\$METADATA_KEYS" input_unmerged.mtz out/careless && cp -f out/careless_0.mtz out/merged.mtz && cp -f out/careless_predictions_0.mtz out/predictions.mtz && if [ -f out/careless_xval_0.mtz ]; then cp -f out/careless_xval_0.mtz out/xval.mtz; else cp -f out/careless_0.mtz out/xval.mtz; fi && python -c " import json, os, gemmi, numpy as np import reciprocalspaceship as rs from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
summary = {'status': 'ok'} mtz = gemmi.read_mtz_file('out/merged.mtz') cols = {c.label: np.array(c, dtype=np.float64) for c in mtz.columns} I = cols.get('I', cols.get('I(+)', np.array([]))) SigI = cols.get('SigI', cols.get('SigI(+)', np.array([]))) valid = np.isfinite(I) & np.isfinite(SigI) & (SigI > 0) summary['n_merged_asu'] = int(np.sum(valid)) summary['mean_isigi'] = float(np.mean(I[valid] / SigI[valid])) if np.any(valid) else 0.0
n_obs = 0 if os.path.exists('out/predictions.mtz'): pmtz = gemmi.read_mtz_file('out/predictions.mtz') n_obs = int(pmtz.nreflections) summary['n_observations'] = n_obs summary['mean_multiplicity'] = float(n_obs / max(1, summary['n_merged_asu'])) if summary['n_merged_asu'] > 0 else 0.0
try: h_m = cols['H'][valid].astype(int) k_m = cols['K'][valid].astype(int) l_m = cols['L'][valid].astype(int) d_m = np.array([mtz.cell.calculate_d([int(hh), int(kk), int(ll)]) for hh, kk, ll in zip(h_m, k_m, l_m)]) dmin_obs = float(np.min(d_m)) if len(d_m) else 2.0 theo_asu = rs.utils.generate_reciprocal_asu(mtz.cell, mtz.spacegroup, dmin_obs) summary['n_theoretical_asu'] = int(len(theo_asu)) summary['completeness_pct'] = float(100.0 * summary['n_merged_asu'] / max(1, len(theo_asu))) summary['d_min'] = round(dmin_obs, 3) summary['d_max'] = round(float(np.max(d_m)), 3) if len(d_m) else 10.0 except Exception as e: summary['completeness_error'] = str(e)
if os.path.exists('out/careless_xval_0.mtz'): xv = gemmi.read_mtz_file('out/careless_xval_0.mtz') xcols = {c.label: np.array(c, dtype=np.float64) for c in xv.columns} h = xcols['H'].astype(int); k = xcols['K'].astype(int); l = xcols['L'].astype(int) half = xcols.get('half', np.zeros_like(h)).astype(int) xI = xcols.get('I', xcols.get('F', np.zeros_like(xcols['H']))) d_arr = np.array([xv.cell.calculate_d([int(hh), int(kk), int(ll)]) for hh, kk, ll in zip(h, k, l)]) m0 = half == 0; m1 = half == 1 map0 = {(int(hh), int(kk), int(ll)): (float(val), float(dd)) for hh, kk, ll, val, dd in zip(h[m0], k[m0], l[m0], xI[m0], d_arr[m0]) if np.isfinite(val)} map1 = {(int(hh), int(kk), int(ll)): float(val) for hh, kk, ll, val in zip(h[m1], k[m1], l[m1], xI[m1]) if np.isfinite(val)} common = [key for key in map0 if key in map1] if len(common) >= 3: v0 = np.array([map0[k][0] for k in common]) v1 = np.array([map1[k] for k in common]) d_c = np.array([map0[k][1] for k in common]) summary['cc_half'] = float(pearsonr(v0, v1)[0]) summary['cc_half_spearman'] = float(spearmanr(v0, v1)[0]) inv_d2 = 1.0 / np.maximum(d_c ** 2, 1e-6) edges = np.linspace(inv_d2.min(), inv_d2.max(), 11) bins = [] for b in range(10): bm = (inv_d2 >= edges[b]) & (inv_d2 <= edges[b+1] if b == 9 else inv_d2 < edges[b+1]) cc_b = float(pearsonr(v0[bm], v1[bm])[0]) if np.sum(bm) >= 3 else float('nan') d_hi = float(1.0 / np.sqrt(max(edges[b+1], 1e-6))) d_lo = float(1.0 / np.sqrt(max(edges[b], 1e-6))) bins.append({'bin': b, 'd_max': round(d_lo, 2), 'd_min': round(d_hi, 2), 'n_refl': int(np.sum(bm)), 'cc_half': round(cc_b, 4) if np.isfinite(cc_b) else None}) summary['resolution_bins'] = bins with open('out/careless_metrics.json', 'w') as fh: json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2) "

param.name: studenttDof
param.label: Student-t likelihood degrees of freedom (empty for Gaussian)

tool.help: Polychromatic / Laue variational scaling and merging of unmerged subhkl MTZ reflections using CUDA-enabled Careless.
